health.title: Degraded stream
health.detail: {reason} Check your upload connection or lower the encoding bitrate.
remote.previewActive: Your program is being watched remotely.
token.title: Link to the plugin
token.description: Paste the session token shown in the OBS dock to control the plugin from this page.
token.note: The token is regenerated every time OBS starts.
pairing.descriptionWaiting: Approve the request on the page that just opened in your browser.
pairing.descriptionIdle: Link OBS to your Semirprod account to access your streams and broadcast settings.
pairing.codeHidden: Hidden so it doesn’t show on stream: anyone who reads it can take over this OBS.
update.blockedSecurity: Version blocked because of a security flaw
update.resumesAfterLive: Remote control will resume when the stream or recording ends.
update.pausedUntilInstalled: The plugin is paused until it is installed.
update.securityAdvice: Update the plugin to resume remote control. Your current stream is not interrupted.
update.criticalNotes: The plugin may stop working properly until it is installed.
subscribe.title: Subscription required
subscribe.message: Going live is blocked until your account has an active Semirprod subscription.
stats.title: Live
stats.idle: No stream in progress. Metrics appear as soon as the stream starts.
connections.title: Connections
connections.link.interruptedHint: valid session, real time cut off
sessions.title: Recent streams
sessions.empty: No stream recorded. A report is added at the end of every stream longer than 30 seconds.
broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.description: Stream destination and machine load during the stream.
broadcast.noStreams: No stream available on this account. Create a stream from the Semirprod dashboard.
broadcast.streamHint: The stream this workstation listens to: its video feeds the sources left on automatic, and it triggers the fallback scene.
broadcast.previewHint: Sends a preview of the OBS output to the dashboard and the mobile app. Turn it off if the machine is under load: no preview encoding will run.
streams.title: My streams
streams.description: Each stream can become a source in your scenes. A source added here keeps its stream, even when the workstation changes its own.
streams.empty: No stream on this account. Create a stream from the Semirprod dashboard.
scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Maps the stream state to your OBS scenes.
scenes.liveHint: Shown when the stream is received.
scenes.fallbackHint: Shown when the stream is cut or degraded.
scenes.autoSwitchHint: Switches on its own between the live scene and the fallback scene depending on the stream state.
scenes.sourceMissingHint: The automatic switch can't work: it needs a source in your live scene.
scenes.sourceMissingElsewhere: The automatic switch can't work: it needs a source in your live scene. It is currently in {scenes}.
machine.title: This machine
machine.description: Workstation identity and local network diagnostics.
machine.nameHint: Shown in the dashboard's instance picker when several PCs stream for the same organization.
machine.testHint: Measures the response time of the Semirprod servers from this machine. Run it before a client stream.
account.title: Account
collections.title: Collections
collections.unsupported: This plugin version can't back up collections yet. Update it.
collections.pausedBackupHint: Packaging reads the whole disk: it waits for the stream to end.
collections.pausedImportHint: The import waits for the stream to end.
collections.none: No scene collection in this OBS.

collections.import.missingSources.one: {count} source needs a plugin that is missing on this workstation.
collections.import.missingSources.other: {count} sources need a plugin that is missing on this workstation.

collections.select.title: Choose collections
collections.select.description: Scenes, sources, filters and media are sent together. Lua and Python scripts are not included.
collections.detail.description: Importing adds the collection to this OBS, with its media. Your open collection is not touched.
collections.detail.versionsHint: Import always uses the most recent one. The full history is on the website.
collections.detail.thirdPartyHint: They will be missing if the plugin isn't installed on this workstation. The media will be there.
